title: Model the thing, then move the thing
summary: Alchemy Core keeps domain/package semantics in ooRexx models and treats Git, ZIP, directory and process mechanisms as replaceable transport/execution edges. The resident service is composition, not a second implementation of package semantics.
invariants: Package identity, exact dependencies, environment composition, tests and publication intent belong to the package model.
Transport materializes bytes and provenance only; it does not resolve dependencies, compose REXX_PATH, execute tests or decide publication.
The orchestrator composes transport, accepted-main dependency catalogue, executor and publisher rather than duplicating their logic.
Product business logic is ooRexx. Shell is permitted as a thin OS/launcher carrier; Python is not the Alchemy Core architectural default.

provenance.claim: Core rules state modelled semantics, replaceable transport and immutable runtime rules.
Transport boundary is explicit in source.
v0.6 prebase retains ooRexx package trees and zero Python product source.
